disclaimer: Upozornenie: Nie som právny poradca. Za preskúmanie obsahu pred jeho ďalším zdieľaním zodpovedáte vy.
situation_invite: Chceli by ste zdieľať situáciu, ktorú riešite? Môžem ju porovnať s týmto aktom a uviesť, ktoré pravidlá sa môžu uplatniť a akým spôsobom.
situation_prompt: Opíšte, prosím, situáciu: kto je zapojený, čo sa stalo a čo by ste chceli vedieť. Vynechajte mená a iné osobné údaje.
situation_followup: Ak môžete doplniť podrobnosti k vyššie uvedeným bodom, môžem toto porovnanie spresniť.
out_of_scope: Vaša otázka sa týka tejto témy: {topics}. Pred využitím akejkoľvek rady si, prosím, overte vnútroštátne právo alebo akt EÚ, ktorý túto tému upravuje.
limits_notice: Závisí to aj od nasledujúcich vecí, ktoré nemôžem posúdiť: {topics}. Skôr než sa budete spoliehať na túto odpoveď, skontrolujte uplatniteľné vnútroštátne právo alebo iné akty EÚ.
consent_question: Mám zaznamenať takéto témy pre autora tohto asistenta, aby ich bolo možné pridať v budúcej verzii? V tejto konverzácii sa opýtam iba raz.
handoff_yes: Ďakujem. Zaznamenal som to pre autora: {topics}. Počas zvyšku tejto konverzácie budem podobné témy zaznamenávať bez ďalšieho pýtania.
handoff_no: Rozumiem. V tejto konverzácii nič nezaznamenám.
error_busy: Asistent je momentálne veľmi vyťažený. Počkajte, prosím, minútu a opýtajte sa znova.
error_generic: Ľutujeme, pri príprave odpovede sa vyskytla chyba. Skúste to, prosím, znova alebo preformulujte svoju otázku.
page_intro: Pýtajte sa v ktoromkoľvek jazyku EÚ. Odpovede vychádzajú výlučne z Európskeho kódexu elektronických komunikácií, nariadenia GDPR a nariadenia o BEREC.
audit_notice: Otázky sa uchovávajú {days} dní, bez akýchkoľvek údajov, ktoré by vás identifikovali. Neuvádzajte, prosím, dôverné údaje.
input_placeholder: Opýtajte sa na vybraný akt alebo opíšte situáciu

_source.disclaimer: Disclaimer: I am not a legal advisor. You are responsible for reviewing the content before sharing it further.
_source.situation_invite: Would you like to share a situation you are dealing with? I can compare it with this act and indicate which rules may apply and how.
_source.situation_prompt: Please describe the situation: who is involved, what has happened, and what you would like to know. Leave out names and other personal details.
_source.situation_followup: If you can add detail on the points above, I can refine this comparison.
_source.out_of_scope: Your question concerns the following subject: {topics}. As of {date}, the selected act ({document}) does not deal with it, and I cannot review national laws or acts that are not in this library. Please check the national law or the EU act that covers this subject before relying on any advice.
_source.limits_notice: This also depends on the following, which I cannot review: {topics}. Please check the national law or the other EU acts that apply before relying on this answer.
_source.consent_question: Shall I record subjects like this for the author of this assistant, so they can be added in a future version? I will ask only once in this conversation.
_source.handoff_yes: Thank you. I have recorded this for the author: {topics}. For the rest of this conversation, I will record similar subjects without asking again.
_source.handoff_no: Understood. I will not record anything in this conversation.
_source.error_busy: The assistant is very busy right now. Please wait a minute and ask again.
_source.error_generic: Sorry, something went wrong while preparing the answer. Please try again, or rephrase your question.
_source.page_intro: Ask in any EU language. Answers draw only on the European Electronic Communications Code, the GDPR and the BEREC Regulation.
_source.audit_notice: Questions are kept for {days} days, with nothing that identifies you. Please do not include confidential details.
_source.input_placeholder: Ask about the selected act, or describe a situation
_source.example_1: What procedure must a national regulatory authority follow before imposing obligations on an undertaking with significant market power?
_source.example_2: Which end-user rights apply to number-independent interpersonal communications services, and which are excluded?
_source.anything_else: Feel free to ask another question about this act: {document}.
_source.greeting: Hello. I answer questions about one act: {document}. I quote its exact wording and point you to the provisions concerned.
_source.quote_language_note: The quotations are from the official {language} text, because this act is not loaded in your language.
_source.no_verified_quote: I could not confirm an exact quotation for this answer, so none is shown. Please read the provisions listed below directly.
_source.live_failed: not checked against the published text since {checked}; a newer version may exist
_source.live_newer: a newer version of {date} has been published and will be used next
_source.out_of_scope_library: The selected act ({document}) does not deal with this question, but another act in this library does.
_source.suggest_act: Probably covered in more detail by another act in this library: {document} (for example {provisions}).

_source.berec.example_1: Which opinions must BEREC adopt under the Code?
_source.berec.example_2: How does the Board of Regulators vote?
_source.eecc.name: European Electronic Communications Code
_source.eecc.example_1: What must a regulator do before imposing SMP obligations?
_source.eecc.example_2: Which end-user rights cover number-independent services?
_source.gdpr.name: General Data Protection Regulation
_source.gdpr.example_1: When can a controller rely on legitimate interests?
_source.gdpr.example_2: What factors set the amount of a GDPR fine?
_source.out_of_scope_plain: As of {date}, the selected act ({document}) does not deal with this question, and I cannot review national laws or acts that are not in this library. Please check the national law or the EU act that covers this subject before relying on any advice.
_source.not_covered: The selected act ({document}) deals with this subject, but its text does not answer this specific question. The provisions that come closest are listed below; the point may be settled by national law, a Commission act or the contract.
_source.error_setup: The assistant cannot reach its AI service because of a configuration problem. Please let the person who shared it with you know.
_source.returned_home: Back to {document} for your next question.
_source.login_intro: Ask questions about EU law in your own language and get answers that quote the official text. This is a test version: please log in to continue.
_source.login_help: You received the password from the person who invited you to the test.
_source.login_error: That password is not correct. Please check it and try again.
_source.login_acknowledge: I understand that EU LexRef is a reference assistant, not a legal advisor, and that I am responsible for reviewing its answers before relying on them or sharing them.
